zh: 支持在网盘与 WebDAV 设置中选择当前同步来源，分别保留各来源的游戏库关联和存档同步配置，切换时不再重新整理整个游戏库。
文件夹卡片只显示当前来源中已有对应内容的云端目录，不再把预设上传路径显示为已有同步关联；已创建的资源任务继续使用原来源。
首次升级会在复古猫启动界面显示加载进度并整理已有资料，支持中断后恢复；已完成整理的游戏库无需重复处理。
修复雷电2等包含较多 ROM 版本的街机游戏上传时提示硬件资料无效的问题。
优化游戏库切换机种时的过渡效果。
修复从更新提示弹窗打开更新日志的问题。
en: Choose the active sync source in cloud and WebDAV settings. Library associations and save sync settings are retained separately for each source, without reorganizing the entire library when switching.

Folder cards show remote directories only when the active source has matching content, instead of treating preset upload paths as existing sync associations. Existing resource tasks keep their original source.
The first upgrade shows loading progress in RetroMao while preparing existing library data, with recovery after interruption. Libraries that have already completed this step do not repeat it.
Fixed uploads of arcade games with many ROM variants, such as Raiden II, failing with an invalid hardware information error.
Improved transitions when switching platforms in the game library.
Fixed opening release notes from the update prompt.
